title: Canonical data for closed-section compact origin
statement: For the finite coefficient setting P of [def-pur-conventions], on the ordinary etale and pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], retain the degree-zero constant objects, closed-image constant objects, actual constant comparison chi and supported-constant comparison epsilon. For a closed section s of a compactifiable f, retain its proper/exact closed-image identifications, the etale and origin compact-support composition/equality/identity maps Sigma_e and Sigma_p, the inverse compact-support site comparison beta, the comparison F^p(theta) beta, the induced maps Tau_e and Tau_p, and the explicit source and target etale-origin witnesses. These are precisely the existing declarations moved unchanged from Sheaf.Paper.ClosedSectionCompactOrigin to its public support module, with the same fully qualified names, types and bodies.
